title: 之乎者也
creator: 罗大佑
note: 一把电吉他把文言成语砸进摇滚，被奉为台湾流行音乐百佳第一的破格之作。
noteEn: Anchoring classical idioms to electric rock, it is crowned No.1 in Taiwan's 100 Best Pop Albums.

title: 范特西
creator: 周杰伦
note: 双截棍、爱在西元前、安静——一张专辑定义华语 R&B 的黄金范式，金曲奖最佳专辑。
noteEn: With 'Nunchucks' and 'Love Before A.D.', one album set the golden template for Mandarin R&B.

title: 淡淡幽情
creator: 邓丽君
note: 把宋词谱曲成歌，邓丽君最「文人」的一张，词牌与气声互为表里。
noteEn: Setting Song-dynasty ci poetry to melody, Teresa Teng's most literary album pairs ancient lyrics with her signature breathy voice.

title: 新长征路上的摇滚
en: Rock on the New Long March
creator: 崔健
note: 《一无所有》之外，崔健把迷茫与反叛焊进摇滚，中国摇滚的起点。
noteEn: Beyond 'Nothing to My Name', Cui Jian welded restlessness into rock — the starting point of Chinese rock.

title: 浮躁
creator: 王菲
note: 几乎全中文创作，王菲最任性的一张，梦呓式吟唱裹着北京摇滚的底色。
noteEn: Almost entirely self-penned, Faye Wong's most willful record, mixing dreamy scat-singing with Beijing-rock textures.

title: 口是心非
creator: 张雨生
note: 张雨生最后的完整作品，编曲繁复的摇滚概念专辑，翌年追授金曲奖最佳专辑。
noteEn: Chang Yu-sheng's final full album — an intricately arranged rock statement that took the Golden Melody Best Album a year later.

title: 生命中的精灵
creator: 李宗盛
note: 李宗盛首张个人专辑，城市男性的心事独白，语感即是旋律。
noteEn: Jonathan Lee's solo debut — intimate monologues of urban men where speech rhythm becomes melody.

title: 吻别
creator: 张学友
note: 情歌时代的高峰，同名主打在华语圈家喻户晓，Jacky 以气声统治九十年代。
noteEn: The peak of the love-song era; its title track is ubiquitous across the Sinophone world and defined Jacky Cheung's 90s.

title: 红
creator: 张国荣
note: 张国荣×林夕×C.Y.Kong 的铁三角，红是华语流行最妖冶的艺术人格。
noteEn: The triad of Leslie Cheung, Lin Xi and C.Y. Kong; 'Red' is the most androgynous art-persona in Mandarin pop.

title: 爱的根源
creator: 谭咏麟
note: 谭咏麟全盛期神作，奠定香港都会情歌的录音室美学。
noteEn: Alan Tam at his peak; a studio masterpiece that defined Hong Kong's metropolitan love-song sound.

title: 石头记
en: Shi Tou Ji (The Story of the Stone)
creator: 达明一派
note: 以《红楼梦》入歌，电子编曲包裹文言意象，香港新浪潮的巅峰。
noteEn: Adapting Dream of the Red Chamber into synth-pop, it marks the zenith of Hong Kong's new-wave scene.

title: 乐与怒
creator: Beyond
note: 收录《海阔天空》，黄家驹离世前的绝唱，理想主义者的墓志铭。
noteEn: Housing 'Boundless Oceans, Vast Skies', it stands as Wong Ka-kui's final testament before his death.

title: 橄榄树
creator: 齐豫
note: 三毛作词的《橄榄树》让齐豫的声音成为台湾民歌运动的化身。
noteEn: With lyrics by Sanmao, 'Olive Tree' made Chyi Yu's voice the embodiment of Taiwan's folk-song movement.

title: 搭错车
en: Papa, Can You Hear Me Sing? (Original Soundtrack)
creator: 苏芮
note: 《酒干倘卖无》《一样的月光》——苏芮把西洋摇滚嗓带进华语电影配乐。
noteEn: With 'Wine Glasses' and 'Same Moon', Su Rui's Western rock voice electrified a Chinese film score for the first time.

title: Love, Sandy
creator: 林忆莲
note: 李宗盛为其量身打造，都市女性情歌的教科书，伤痕与缠绵并存。
noteEn: Tailored by Jonathan Lee, it is the textbook of urban women's ballads — wounds wrapped in tenderness.

title: 姊妹
creator: 张惠妹
note: 出道即巅峰，原住民的力量嗓音刷新华语女声标准。
noteEn: A debut at full power; A-Mei's indigenous-rooted voice reset the bar for Mandarin female vocals.

title: 征服
creator: 那英
note: 那英北派大气嗓的国民代表作，同名主打唱进 KTV 殿堂。
noteEn: Na Ying's signature big-voice anthem, a national hit that became a karaoke staple.

title: 我去2000年
creator: 朴树
note: 《那些花儿》《白桦林》——千禧前夕内地独立流行的青春碑。
noteEn: With 'Those Flowers' and 'Birch Forest', it is the monument of pre-millennium Chinese indie pop.

title: 那一年
creator: 许巍
note: 许巍从地下摇滚转向温暖民谣的转折点，吉他声如秋天。
noteEn: Xu Wei's pivot from underground rock to warm balladry, with guitars that feel like autumn.

title: 黑梦
creator: 窦唯
note: 窦唯首张个人专辑，梦呓与鼓机营造的黑暗美学，领先时代十年。
noteEn: Dou Wei's solo debut, a dark dreamscape of mumbles and drum machines a decade ahead of its time.

title: 赤裸裸
creator: 郑钧
note: 《回到拉萨》与同名主打——西式摇滚与西北血脉混血的内地经典。
noteEn: With 'Return to Lhasa', Zheng Jun's raw fusion of Western rock and northwest-China roots.

title: 唐朝
creator: 唐朝乐队
note: 《梦回唐朝》以重金属书写盛唐气象，中国摇滚最壮阔的想象。
noteEn: Heavy-metal grandeur conjuring the Tang dynasty — Chinese rock's most epic vision.

title: 黑豹
creator: 黑豹乐队
note: 《Don't Break My Heart》让摇滚第一次进入内地主流视野。
noteEn: 'Don't Break My Heart' brought rock into China's mainstream consciousness.

title: 万能青年旅店
creator: 万能青年旅店
note: 《杀死那个石家庄人》——华北小城抑郁与爵士摇滚十年一遇的杰作。
noteEn: With 'Kill That Shijiazhuang Person', a once-a-decade jazz-rock portrait of northern-town ennui.

title: 黑白灰
creator: 陈奕迅
note: 《十年》《兄妹》——Eason 用三色概念划分都市情感的三种灰。
noteEn: With 'Ten Years' and 'Brother & Sister', Eason maps urban emotion in three shades.

title: 还是会寂寞
creator: 陈绮贞
note: 陈绮贞第二张，把吉他民谣做成文艺青年的身份徽章。
noteEn: Cheer Chen's second album turned guitar folk into the badge of a generation's literary youth.

title: David Tao
creator: 陶喆
note: 《爱，很简单》——陶喆把美式 R&B 缝进华语歌词，宣告新派情歌。
noteEn: With 'Love, It's Simple', David Tao stitched American R&B into Mandarin lyrics, ushering a new pop.

title: 公转自转
creator: 王力宏
note: 王力宏凭此拿下金曲奖最佳男演唱人，美式唱作站稳华语。
noteEn: Wang Leehom's Golden Melody-winning Best Male Vocalist record planted American songwriting in Mandopop.

title: Soul Boy
creator: 方大同
note: 香港罕见的灵魂乐全创作，方大同以律动重塑华语男声。
noteEn: Hong Kong's rare all-original soul album; Khalil Fong rebuilt the Mandarin male voice on groove.

title: 孙燕姿
creator: 孙燕姿
note: 《天黑黑》——新加坡短发女孩用清亮中音横扫华语乐坛。
noteEn: With 'Dark Sky', the short-haired Singaporean swept the Sinophone charts with a crystalline mid-range.

title: 看我72变
creator: 蔡依林
note: Jolin 转型唱跳天后之作，舞曲美学正式接管华语女歌手。
noteEn: Jolin's reinvention into a dance diva — club-ready pop took over Mandarin female stardom.

title: 叶惠美
creator: 周杰伦
note: 《东风破》《晴天》——周杰伦「中国风」开山金曲专辑，金曲奖最佳专辑。
noteEn: With 'East Wind Breaks' and 'Sunny Day', the album that birthed Jay's Chinese-style hits and won the Golden Melody Best Album.

title: 第二人生
creator: 五月天
note: 末日与重生双概念，2012 金曲奖最佳国语专辑的摇滚大碟。
noteEn: A dual concept of apocalypse and rebirth; the rock album that took the 2012 Golden Melody Best Album.

title: 跟你说 听你说
en: Talk to You, Listen to You
creator: 陈淑桦
note: 《梦醒时分》——李宗盛操刀的都会情歌，台湾百万销量的城市蓝调。
noteEn: With 'Dream Awake', Jonathan Lee's urban balladry made Sarah Chen a million-selling Taipei voice.

title: 冰的世界
creator: 井上阳水
note: 日本唱片史首张销量破百万的专辑，井上阳水以民谣与意象统治七十年代。
noteEn: Japan's first million-selling album; Yōsui Inoue's folk-poetry ruled the early 70s.

title: For You
creator: 山下达郎
note: City Pop 的教科书，夏季海岸与合成器的完美共振。
noteEn: A textbook of city pop — the perfect resonance of summer coasts and synths.

title: A Long Vacation
creator: 大泷咏一
note: 大泷咏一的盛夏概念专辑，City Pop 命名的重要源头之一。
noteEn: Ōtaki's midsummer concept album and one of the wellsprings of the 'city pop' name.

title: Variety
creator: 竹内まりや
note: 《Plastic Love》的原点，被互联网重新发现的昭和都会律动。
noteEn: The source of 'Plastic Love', a Shōwa urban groove rediscovered by the internet.

title: Solid State Survivor
creator: Yellow Magic Orchestra
note: YMO 第二张专辑，把 Techno 流行化的世界宣言，《Behind the Mask》走向全球。
noteEn: YMO's second LP turned techno into pop and sent 'Behind the Mask' around the world.

title: 细野之家
creator: 细野晴臣
note: 细野晴臣用低保真乡谣开启 Exotica 与民谣的私人宇宙。
noteEn: Haruomi Hosono's lo-fi folk home-studio universe that seeded Japanese exotica.

title: 千之刃
creator: 坂本龙一
note: 坂本龙一将电子乐与亚欧传统素材并置，学院派的先锋起点。
noteEn: Ryuichi Sakamoto fusing electronics with Asian and European traditions — an academician's avant-garde debut.

title: Blue Blood
creator: X Japan
note: Visual Kei 的圣经，华丽金属包裹着古典钢琴的底色。
noteEn: The bible of visual kei — glam metal wrapped around classical piano.

title: 深海
creator: Mr.Children
note: Mr.Children 最深邃的一张，把通俗摇滚做成文学。
noteEn: Mr.Children's deepest record, turning mass-market rock into literature.

title: First Love
creator: 宇多田光
note: 日本史上销量最高的专辑，15 岁的宇多田光定义了平成 R&B 流行。
noteEn: Japan's best-selling album ever; a 15-year-old Utada defined Heisei R&B pop.

title: SWEET 19 BLUES
creator: 安室奈美惠
note: 安室 19 岁的出道告白，日本女歌手销量纪录的缔造者。
noteEn: Namie's coming-of-age statement at 19, setting a sales record for a solo female artist.

title: 无罪偿债期
creator: 椎名林檎
note: 椎名林檎的病娇美学与涩谷系编曲，J-Pop 最异色的天才登场。
noteEn: Shiina Ringo's debut — her ailing-girlish aesthetics and Shibuya-kei arrangements announced a singular genius.

title: 教育
creator: 东京事变
note: 东京事变首张，把摇滚与爵士学院化，椎名林檎的集体变奏。
noteEn: Tokyo Jihen's debut academizing rock and jazz — Ringo's collective reinvention.

title: Game
creator: Perfume
note: 电音女团 Perfume 的主流突破，极简 Techno 与偶像文化的结合。
noteEn: Perfume's mainstream breakthrough, marrying minimal techno with idol culture.

title: BOOTLEG
creator: 米津玄师
note: 《打上花火》与《Loser》——米津玄师从 Vocaloid 到国民创作人的登基。
noteEn: With 'Uchiage Hanabi' and 'Loser', Yonezu ascended from Vocaloid to national songwriter.

title: 徐太志和孩子们
creator: 徐太志和孩子们
note: 《Nan Arayo》引爆韩国乐坛地震，K-Pop 真正的创世纪。
noteEn: With 'I Know', Seo Taiji's debut shook Korea — the true genesis of K-pop.

title: 反对一切暴力
en: We Hate All Kinds of Violence… (H.O.T.)
creator: H.O.T.
note: 第一代偶像男团的起点，H.O.T. 定义了 K-Pop 的粉丝工业。
noteEn: The start of the first-generation idol boy band, defining K-pop's fandom industry.

title: MADE
creator: BIGBANG
note: 《Bang Bang Bang》与《Loser》——BIGBANG 对 K-Pop EDM 时代的声音总结。
noteEn: With 'Bang Bang Bang' and 'Loser', BIGBANG's assembled masterwork of K-pop's EDM era.

title: Love Yourself 转 Tear
creator: BTS 防弹少年团
note: 首张登顶 Billboard 200 的 K-Pop 专辑，《Fake Love》席卷全球。
noteEn: The first K-pop album to top the Billboard 200, with 'Fake Love' sweeping the globe.

title: THE ALBUM
creator: BLACKPINK
note: BLACKPINK 首张正规专辑，Girl Crush 美学的全球总攻。
noteEn: BLACKPINK's debut LP — the global assault of the 'girl crush' aesthetic.

title: XOXO
creator: EXO
note: 时隔 12 年韩国首张百万销量专辑，《咆哮》确立新世代男团秩序。
noteEn: Korea's first million-selling album in 12 years; 'Growl' crowned the new boy-group order.

title: The Boys
creator: 少女时代
note: 少女时代进军美国之作，K-Pop 女团工业化的巅峰展示。
noteEn: Girls' Generation's U.S.-bound statement, a peak display of the industrialized K-pop girl group.

title: Palette
creator: IU
note: IU 从国民妹妹到创作歌手的成年礼，慵懒而自洽。
noteEn: IU's coming-of-age from nation's little sister to singer-songwriter — languid and self-possessed.

title: PLAY
creator: 乐童音乐家
note: 兄妹俩的清新民谣奇想，《200%》里都是元音的游戏。
noteEn: Siblings' winsome folk-pop fantasy, with the vowel-play of '200%'.

title: 重返61号公路
creator: Bob Dylan
note: 《Like a Rolling Stone》开创民谣摇滚纪元，电吉他对民谣的背叛与新生。
noteEn: 'Like a Rolling Stone' announced the folk-rock era — electric betrayal and rebirth of folk.

title: 路上的血迹
creator: Bob Dylan
note: 离婚阴霾下的叙事巅峰，Dylan 把私生活写成美国神话。
noteEn: Dylan's narrative peak under the shadow of divorce, turning private pain into American myth.

title: 福尔松监狱现场
creator: Johnny Cash
note: 在囚犯面前录制的现场专辑，把乡村乐带回它的阶级根源。
noteEn: Recorded before inmates, it returned country to its class roots.

title: 美国 IV：人终将逝去
en: American IV: The Man Comes Around
creator: Johnny Cash
note: 病榻前的翻唱绝唱，一曲《Hurt》的苍凉让一代人重新认识死亡。
noteEn: A cover masterwork from the sickbed; 'Hurt' taught a generation about mortality.

title: 蓝色
creator: Joni Mitchell
note: 自我剖白的极致，把心碎唱成冰蓝色的透明。
noteEn: The apogee of confession, singing heartbreak in crystalline blue.

title: 忧愁河上的金桥
creator: Simon & Garfunkel
note: 同名主打是流行乐史上最动人的二重唱之一，解散前的谢幕，格莱美年度专辑。
noteEn: Its title track is one of pop's most moving duets — a farewell that won the Grammy Album of the Year.

title: 丰收
creator: Neil Young
note: 《Heart of Gold》与乡谣弦乐，木吉他叙事与时代挽歌并存。
noteEn: With 'Heart of Gold', rustic acoustic country meets an era's elegy.

title: 甜心詹姆斯
creator: James Taylor
note: 《Fire and Rain》把歌手-创作人运动推向主流。
noteEn: 'Fire and Rain' carried the singer-songwriter movement mainstream.

title: 织锦
creator: Carole King
note: 《It's Too Late》——从幕后写手到前台歌后的转型范本，格莱美年度专辑。
noteEn: With 'It's Too Late', the songwriter's leap to front-stage stardom; Grammy Album of the Year.

title: 沙尘暴民谣
creator: Woody Guthrie
note: 《This Land Is Your Land》的作者把大萧条写进美国歌本。
noteEn: The work of 'This Land Is Your Land''s author, setting the Depression to song.

title: 汤斯·范·赞特
creator: Townes Van Zandt
note: 被低估的吟游诗人，《Pancho and Lefty》是他留给世界的情书。
noteEn: The under-sung troubadour whose 'Pancho and Lefty' is a love letter to the world.

title: 粉月
creator: Nick Drake
note: 仅以人声与吉他录制的告别，忧郁到近乎透明。
noteEn: Recorded with just voice and guitar — a farewell so melancholy it turns translucent.

title: 莱昂纳德·科恩之歌
creator: Leonard Cohen
note: 《Suzanne》与诗人的低音，把文学性带进民谣的深渊。
noteEn: With 'Suzanne', the poet's bass-baritone dropped literature into folk's depths.

title: 农夫之茶
creator: Cat Stevens
note: 《Wild World》与《Father and Son》，70 年代最温柔的哲学民谣。
noteEn: With 'Wild World' and 'Father and Son', the gentlest philosophizing of 70s folk.

title: 破城锤
creator: Emmylou Harris
note: Daniel Lanois 操刀，用氛围声景重造乡村乐，格莱美最佳当代民谣专辑。
noteEn: Produced by Daniel Lanois, it rebuilt country through ambient soundscapes and won a Grammy.

title: 砾石路上的车轮
en: Car Wheels on a Gravel Road
creator: Lucinda Williams
note: 八年的打磨换来南方叙事的琥珀，格莱美最佳当代民谣专辑。
noteEn: Eight years of polish yielding amber Southern narratives; Grammy Best Contemporary Folk Album.

title: 这一切没有想象的那么糟
en: It's Not as Bad as You Think
creator: 万晓利
note: 《狐狸》《陀螺》——万晓利把民谣玩成机智的黑色寓言。
noteEn: With 'The Fox' and 'Spinning Top', Wan Xiaoli turns folk into wry dark fables.

title: 中国孩子
creator: 周云蓬
note: 盲诗人用歌声给底层写传，诗意与愤怒并存的民谣良心。
noteEn: A blind poet singing for the dispossessed — folk's conscience where poetry meets anger.

title: 白银饭店
creator: 张玮玮和郭龙
note: 西北民谣的手风琴挽歌，《米店》的情歌至今仍在回响。
noteEn: Accordion elegies of northwest folk; the love-song 'Rice Shop' still echoes.

title: 昂贵的屎
creator: Fela Kuti
note: Afrobeat 之父的录音室名盘，把政治讽刺与十人铜管熔成一炉。
noteEn: The Afrobeat pioneer's studio classic, fusing political satire with a ten-piece horn section.

title: 沙代
creator: Ofra Haza
note: 《Im Nin'alu》把也门犹太传统与合成器流行嫁接，风靡欧洲舞池。
noteEn: 'Im Nin'alu' grafted Yemenite-Jewish tradition onto synth-pop and conquered European dance floors.

title: 即兴之声
creator: Zakir Hussain
note: 塔布拉鼓王与 Jan Garbarek、John McLaughlin 的 ECM 即兴，印度节奏与北欧萨克斯的对话。
noteEn: The tabla master improvising with Jan Garbarek and John McLaughlin — an ECM dialogue of Indian rhythm and Nordic sax.

title: 帕塔帕塔
creator: Miriam Makeba
note: 非洲母亲让流行乐有了第一个非洲韵律出口。
noteEn: Mama Africa gave pop its first great African-rhythm export.

title: 沙卡·祖鲁
creator: Ladysmith Black Mambazo
note: 祖鲁合唱与《Graceland》一同把南非声音带进西方客厅，格莱美最佳传统民谣。
noteEn: Zulu isicathamiya that, alongside Graceland, carried South African voices into Western homes; Grammy winner.

title: 零点
creator: Astor Piazzolla
note: 新探戈的宣言，手风琴在古典与爵士之间起舞。
noteEn: The manifesto of tango nuevo — the bandoneón dancing between classical and jazz.

title: 卡埃塔诺·维洛索
creator: Caetano Veloso
note: Tropicália 宣言专辑之一，用实验搅动巴西流行乐。
noteEn: A Tropicália manifesto that stirred Brazilian pop with experimentation.

title: 变种人
creator: Os Mutantes
note: 迷幻之声与巴西节奏的嫁接，Tropicália 最狂野的一极。
noteEn: Psychedelia grafted onto Brazilian rhythm — the wildest pole of Tropicália.

title: 学习桑巴
creator: Tom Zé
note: 被大卫·伯恩重新发现的巴西怪才，用解构桑巴预演未来。
noteEn: Rediscovered by David Byrne, Tom Zé deconstructed samba into a preview of the future.

title: 三首拉格
creator: Ravi Shankar
note: 西塔琴大师为西方录制的经典，印度古典乐的世界信使。
noteEn: The sitar master's classic Western release — India's classical ambassador to the world.

title: 孤儿挽歌
creator: Huun-Huur-Tu
note: 图瓦呼麦的喉音合唱，把草原风声装进五声音阶。
noteEn: Tuvan throat-singing ensemble turning steppe wind into pentatonic song.

title: 微笑
creator: Sezen Aksu
note: 土耳其乐坛女王的转折之作，阿拉伯花腔与流行乐的结合。
noteEn: The Turkish queen's pivotal record, fusing arabesque melisma with pop.

title: 你是我的一生
creator: Oum Kalthoum
note: 阿拉伯世界的月亮，一首歌长达四十分钟的即兴史诗。
noteEn: The 'Star of the East' — a 40-minute improvisatory epic that still hypnotizes the Arab world.

title: 眼中的光
creator: Amr Diab
note: 《Habibi Ya Nour El Ain》让埃及流行乐传遍中东与北非。
noteEn: 'Habibi Ya Nour El Ain' carried Egyptian pop across the Middle East and North Africa.

title: 源头与水流
creator: Paco de Lucía
note: 《Entre dos aguas》让弗拉门戈吉他与爵士即兴握手。
noteEn: With 'Entre dos aguas', flamenco guitar shook hands with jazz improvisation.

title: 最后的作品
creator: Violeta Parra
note: 智利民谣之母的绝笔，《Gracias a la vida》的诞生地。
noteEn: The Chilean folk matriarch's final songs — where 'Gracias a la vida' was born.

title: 黄金三镖客
en: The Good, the Bad and the Ugly (Original Soundtrack)
creator: Ennio Morricone
note: 口哨、电吉他与人声合唱，莫里康内把西部片配乐变成艺术。
noteEn: Whistles, electric guitar and choral shouts — Morricone turned Western scoring into art.

title: 天堂电影院
creator: Ennio Morricone
note: 《Love Theme》的弦乐让乡愁可触，莫里康内最柔情的旋律。
noteEn: The 'Love Theme''s strings make nostalgia tangible — Morricone's tenderest melody.

title: 星球大战：新希望
en: Star Wars: A New Hope (Original Soundtrack)
creator: John Williams
note: 开场号角定义了太空歌剧的听觉想象，奥斯卡最佳原创配乐。
noteEn: The opening fanfare defined how space opera should sound; Academy Award-winning score.

title: 辛德勒的名单
creator: John Williams
note: 伊扎克·帕尔曼的小提琴如泣如诉，大屠杀最哀恸的旋律，奥斯卡配乐。
noteEn: Itzhak Perlman's violin weeps through the Holocaust's most mournful theme; Oscar-winning score.

title: 银翼杀手
creator: Vangelis
note: 合成器描绘的霓虹雨夜，赛博朋克配乐的模板。
noteEn: Synths painting a neon rain — the template of cyberpunk scoring.

title: 圣诞快乐，劳伦斯先生
creator: 坂本龙一
note: 同名主题成为坂本龙一最著名的旋律，战争与和解的东方回响。
noteEn: Its title theme is Sakamoto's most famous melody — a reconciliation of East and West amid war.

title: 末代皇帝
creator: 坂本龙一
note: 坂本龙一、大卫·伯恩与苏聪共享奥斯卡，东西配乐的水乳交融。
noteEn: Sakamoto, Byrne and Cong Su shared an Oscar — a seamless East-West fusion.

title: 龙猫
creator: 久石让
note: 《散步》的旋律让宫崎骏的田园魔法有了心跳。
noteEn: 'The Path of the Wind' gave Miyazaki's pastoral magic a heartbeat.

title: 千与千寻
creator: 久石让
note: 《那个夏天》与《第六号站台》，久石让为东方幻想配乐立下标杆。
noteEn: With 'That Summer' and 'The Sixth Station', Hisaishi set the bar for East-Asian fantasy scoring.

title: 教父
creator: Nino Rota
note: 西西里小调的弦乐，让黑帮史诗有了宿命的温柔。
noteEn: Sicilian-inflected strings lent the mafia epic a fatal tenderness.

title: 狮子王
creator: Hans Zimmer
note: 非洲合唱与百老汇旋律合体，奥斯卡最佳原创配乐。
noteEn: African choral textures meet Broadway melody; Academy Award-winning score.

title: 指环王：护戒使者
en: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring (Original Soundtrack)
creator: Howard Shore
note: 霍华德·肖用庞大的主题矩阵为托尔金世界立传，奥斯卡配乐。
noteEn: Howard Shore's vast leitmotif architecture gave Tolkien's world its epic voice; Oscar-winning.

title: 卧虎藏龙
creator: 谭盾
note: 马友友的大提琴与东方打击乐对话，华人首座奥斯卡最佳配乐。
noteEn: Yo-Yo Ma's cello dialogues with Chinese percussion — the first Chinese Academy Award for score.

title: 贫民窟的百万富翁
creator: A.R. Rahman
note: 《Jai Ho》的节庆能量让印度声音登顶奥斯卡。
noteEn: 'Jai Ho''s festive energy carried Indian sound to an Oscar.

title: 爱乐之城
creator: Justin Hurwitz
note: 《City of Stars》重拾歌舞片配乐的爵士灵魂，奥斯卡最佳配乐。
noteEn: 'City of Stars' revived the jazz soul of movie musicals; Academy Award-winning score.
